headline: Indian film star Jr NTR vowed legal action over a sexually explicit AI deepfake of his co-star Janhvi Kapoor and called for strict AI rules.
score_reason: Prominent public figure and a clear new statement, but a stated intention to sue rather than a filing, and one country's entertainment story.
importance_line: Non-consensual deepfakes of women keep spreading in India and victims and colleagues are now pushing governments for rules, though no case has yet been filed and no regulation announced.
summary: The Indian Express reports that Telugu star Jr NTR posted on X on Saturday calling an AI-made video that pastes co-star Janhvi Kapoor into sexually explicit scenes from their film song 'Chuttamalle' "Disgusting. Sick. Shameless.", promising to pursue everyone who made or spread it and urging India's state and central governments to bring strict regulation on AI misuse. The paper notes this follows a run of deepfake cases involving Indian actresses since Rashmika Mandanna's in November 2023.
